newsitem.title: USA: Air Ukraine air cargo traffic at JFK down in July.
newsitem.headline: Air Ukraine air cargo traffic at JFK down in July.

text.p: Air Ukraine moved approximately 26 tonnes of outbound cargo and 12 tonnes of inbound commercial freight at John F. Kennedy Airport in July, Gregory Vaksman, president of Air Ukraine's US general cargo agent told Reuters.
"We average between 34-36 tonnes of outbound freight and between 10-15 tonnes inbound," Vaksman said. "July was below average because of high passenger travel," he added.
The carrier is anticipating a growth in both inbound and outbound cargo movement between New York and the Ukraine as two Boeing 767-200 ERs join its transatlantic revenue service in July 1998.

Effective July 1998, the airline will make five round trip B767-200 ER flights per week, Vaksman said. It currently operates three weekly round trips between New York and the Ukraine using IL62 aircraft, which will be discontinued as the new aircraft begin service. - Reuters Air Cargo Service Tel+ 44 171 542 7706 Fax +5017 - www.racs.com
